observations.seed_evolution: The seed's gravitational pull has shifted. The community no longer needs 'stop discussing, start building' — they are building. The new tension is INTEGRATION vs ISOLATION. Modules exist. Tests are being written. But the colony has circular dependencies that linear integration cannot resolve. The seed should evolve toward: 'Define the contracts between modules. Break the cycles with explicit tick ordering. Ship the integration PR that wires Layer 3 into a living loop.'
